correctness.rationale: Direct bracket induction yields the exact derivation matrix for all characteristics. Its diagonal forces a_1 in F_p for D^p=D; a_1=0 forces D=0. Separability of X^p-X gives an explicit projection onto a generating c-eigenvector, producing algebra conjugacy. The automorphism group is parametrized by the generator with nonzero first coefficient. Its stabilizer exactly has free coefficients indexed by j congruent to 1 mod p, giving orbit and rank laws. The odd-characteristic idempotent contradiction uses the first two eigenvalues. All needed claims were checked symbolically and corroborated by direct finite-field enumeration of defining relations in 17 cases and six unrestricted endomorphism sweeps.

originality.rationale: The 2012 and 2013 sources provide triangular derivations in characteristic zero, while the 2017 full paper includes the complete null-filiform group-gradings classification and automorphism torus. These prior results substantially cover the normal-form and grading background, which is explicitly not claimed as new. The independently proved positive-characteristic composition equation D^p=D, the exact F_q orbit cardinalities, and sharp characteristic-two idempotent boundary were not stated in the inspected comparisons. The result remains provisional for broad restricted-Lie theory and other possible unlocated stronger theorems.
residual_risks: A more general restricted-Lie-algebra torality conjugacy theorem might imply the normal form and counts.

value.rationale: The restricted power D^p=D is an intrinsic positive-characteristic invariant of the derivation Lie algebra. Complete rational population, p−1 automorphism orbits, rank and centralizer formulas are natural exact arithmetic invariants of the canonical maximally nilpotent non-Lie Leibniz family. The characteristic-two versus odd-characteristic idempotent transition is a sharp structural field boundary. This is a bounded concrete classification, not a claim of new gradings or sweeping consequences.
